newsitem.title: USA: FSA says has no exposure to Miami debt.
newsitem.headline: FSA says has no exposure to Miami debt.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it has no exposure to bonds issued by the city of Miami.

The bond insurance company, a unit of Financial Security Assurance Holdings Ltd, said it has not insured any general obligation bonds, revenue bonds, or so-called "non-ad valorem" bonds, which are similar to GOs but rely on different revenue streams.
FSA is the only one of the top four municipal bond insurance companies without any exposure to the cash strapped city, which is facing a $68 million budget gap in its $275 million budget.
Bond insurers guarantee bondholders that, in the event of a default, principal and interest payments will be made as they come due.
All of the major companies with exposure to the city have said over the past two weeks that they are working closely with city and state officials and do not expect a default.
